parameters.query: SELECT id AS conversation_id, tenant_id, contact_id, channel_id, status, assigned_user_id, assigned_agent_id, ai_enabled, priority, last_message_at, created_at FROM conversations WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid AND contact_id = $2::uuid AND channel_id = $3::uuid AND status IN ('open', 'pending') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;

meta.description: Busca conversa aberta por tenant_id, contact_id e channel_id sem criação automática
